work: Accelerando-8192 font and glyph artwork by gillverd, as adapted in Anima: the Accelerando Terminal Regular and Bold fonts and Anima's Accelerando glyph bitmaps
basis: Upstream publishes no license for this artwork, and the license request at https://github.com/gillverd/accelerando-8192/issues/3 had no answer. Eon's maintainer chose MIT for the artwork as Eon ships it; the MIT text is licenses/accelerando-MIT. Anima's NOTICE files, which predate this choice, still describe how the fonts and bitmaps were derived.
